comments.body: Implementation is up for review as PR #357: syn/yosys/result_cache.py (key and hit rule), run.sh --cache/--cache-seed, the rtl.yml per-shard actions/cache step whose GitHub scoping is the #270 trust boundary, a ci_events contract with eight arms, and syn/yosys/cache_selftest.py driving the real gate in rtl-fast. Full-inventory evidence: cold run stores 48 entries with records identical to today's gate; warm run serves 48 of 48 in 34.7 s with every cells= reported; a planted forged entry is refused by name and the top runs live.
